property_summary: For any caller and any nonnegative msg.value, after calling addToBalance() the caller's stored userBalance is equal to its previous balance plus msg.value (i.e., addToBalance never decreases caller balance); the mutant that subtracts msg.value can make the caller's balance decrease for some fuzzed actor/amount.
change_summary: Replace the addition assignment to subtract the incoming msg.value instead of adding it, causing balances to decrease when funds are sent in.
